title: Tower Hill Memorial
geometryBasis: The matched Tower Hill place, both surviving structures and their native features in Trinity Square Gardens. The current garden shape follows the surveyed retaining walls. Existing stone surfaces and architecturally significant form are drawn from the published originals.
sectionBasis: The Environment Agency 1 m terrain delineates the sunken garden’s floor, stair rise and street platform. Individual dimensions for the pavilion superstructure and the gate pylons are approximate from the original photographs and verified architecture description.
limitations: Pavilion roof profile and individual pylon heights are reconstructed from photography at model scale. The plates, decorative relief blocks and compass convey the forms of the memorial at medium detail. Engraved names and individual sculptural likeness are outside the model scope.
Nearby park, 2005 Falklands monument, and unrelated buildings remain supplied by the existing world.
